summary: The mayor thanks people by the work they do, a department or a crew at a time, and sometimes asks the staff in the room to stand or raise a hand.
realLife: In real speeches mayors more often named the people they thanked; the role-only thanks was the quieter pattern. A small-town city thanked a team of eight public works staff by what they do, a state-of-the-city address asked every city employee within earshot to raise a hand, and another mayor thanked each department by its work before naming its director.
sources: Wood Village OR city statement for Public Works Week, 62nd annual Public Works Week (the Mayor, City Council and the City): https://www.woodvillageor.gov/?p=41323
Caroline Torosis, Santa Monica CA mayor, 2026 State of the City address: https://www.santamonica.gov/blog/2026-state-of-the-city-address-mayor-caroline-torosis
